subject: Dynamic Binding Lattice candidate for emergent ClayGraph bindings

delta.core: Develop XENO lattice lineage into three coupled structures: epistemic Witness-Lattice, multi-axis Dynamic Binding Lattice, and Assembly/Hyperbinding lattice. Local coactivation may seed fast bindings; only verified causal credit may consolidate slow bindings. Joint support exceeding pairwise baseline may nucleate candidate n-ary ClayGraph hyperrelations.
delta.boundary: Emergent binding changes derived relevance/topology first; it never promotes semantic truth and never grants execution authority. UnifiedDB remains semantic authority; Needle/Witness path remains effect authority.
delta.promotion: No runtime promotion without executable tests, verified task gain over simpler baselines, acceptable false-binding rate, shuffled-control survival, lesion/rescue causal support, conflict preservation, and verified rollback.
delta.user_origin: User proposed continuing the lattice structures so that they can, among other mechanisms, cause emergent bindings in ClayGraph.
